theme: keeping the crypt of kings dry
title: The Crypt of Kings: Interception Wells
strategies: per-cell isolated well: drop one well on every wet foundation cell, sized as if it were the only well pumping (ignores superposition, pays the fixed drilling cost once per cell)

per-patch greedy: iteratively pump whichever wet foundation cell currently has the largest shortfall, reusing an existing well when the shortfall belongs to an already-drilled cell (benefits from superposition only *within* a contiguous wet patch)

interception-cut search: compare per-cell, per-patch, and a single shared well searched over the cells lying on the graph-distance path between the recharge boundary and the wet patches, keeping whichever partition of the budget is cheapest (exploits superposition *across* patches and the fixed per-well drilling cost)
